concern_summary: This concern focuses on the styling and presentation of text elements, ensuring they are rendered with specific attributes to maintain visual consistency.

Management and interaction of the Left Hand Navigation (LHN) interface, including rendering, item selection, visibility toggling, organization of report groups, and routing adjustments based on application state.
This concern addresses the processing and rendering of text messages, ensuring they are formatted correctly for various contexts including chat and reporting actions.
This concern focuses on managing and displaying formatted monetary amounts, allowing users to input and modify amounts while calculating the associated tax based on user transactions.
This concern involves the creation and presentation of error message text, providing users with information about issues encountered along with help resources.
This concern focuses on the functionalities that handle user input for searching and filtering lists, enabling users to refine their selections based on specific criteria through text inputs.
